patch.content:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)

find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(max17048_test)

target_sources(app PRIVATE src/test_max17048.c)

# The MAX17048 driver source is needed to resolve '__device_dts_ord_38'
# which is an internal symbol generated by the device tree for the driver instance.
target_sources(app PRIVATE
  drivers/fuel_gauge/max17048/max17048.c
)

# The MAX17048 emulator source is needed to resolve 'emul_max17048_set_crate_status'
# which is an API provided by the emulator for testing purposes.
target_sources(app PRIVATE
  drivers/fuel_gauge/max17048/emul_max17048.c
)
